constraint: Consumer layer cannot read activation before producer layer commits it to feature SRAM or DRAM spill path.
note: Current runtime uses feature residency plan and slot tagging.

constraint: Current FPS/KNN query xyz block must be loaded into query SRAM before repeated reads by dist2engine; once loaded it can be reused across key-tile scans.
note: Runtime export support added; full event generation pending.

constraint: Each key xyz tile must be refilled from DRAM into key SRAM before the corresponding dist2engine scan can start.
note: Covers src-read plus tgt-write semantics for each key tile.

constraint: Same feature SRAM slot is exclusive; without pipeline a single slot is reused serially.
Without pipeline or without double buffering, next-layer feature read must wait for previous-layer write completion on the same slot.
base_v1 FPS waits until all distances/min-table updates for one iteration complete before sort starts.
base_v1 KNN waits until all query distances are written to dist SRAM before top-k sort starts.
Weight tile must be refilled into weight_sram_buffer before corresponding Conv/Linear compute tile consumes it.
note: 32KB weight SRAM causes repeated tiled refills in baseline/base_v2.

constraint: AffineNorm/SPool/KAT/ReLU/Add/LayerNorm may start on a chunk only after the corresponding feature chunk is visible in feature SRAM.
note: Matches chunked feature pipeline semantics; runtime still coarse for most nonlinear ops.

constraint: Nonlinear workspace SRAM is shared across AffineNorm/SPool/KAT/Pool-like operators and is exclusive within each active operator window.
note: Future runtime path should map individual ops to this shared workspace resource.

constraint: AffineNorm/LayerNorm/KAT parameter or LUT SRAM must be resident before the corresponding nonlinear engine evaluates the chunk.
note: Small-parameter SRAM is expected to stay resident across many chunks/operators.

constraint: ADD waits for both main tensor and residual tensor to be available; residual may come from feature SRAM or DRAM refill in conservative mode.
note: Residual path can be forced to DRAM in the current conservative baseline assumption.

constraint: weight_sram_buffer is shared across Conv/Linear ops and is exclusive within each active staging window.
Operator-local systolic feature SRAM is serialized on the shared local buffer resource.
Without pipeline or without double buffering, key xyz tile refill and key consumption serialize on the same SRAM buffer.
Distance SRAM write and sorter read must serialize when they target the same shared dist SRAM resource/bank.
note: Current runtime models shared resource IDs; bank-level refinement can be added later.

constraint: FPS min-distance table update and sorter read are mutually exclusive on the same logical table region.
